project_template.name: 云仓商品与库存管理平台
project_template.reference_summary: 参考用户提供的云仓首页截图：品牌导航、产品介绍、进入管理后台入口、核心功能卡片。

database.password_source: local .env only; never put a real password in generated files

content_rules: The public homepage must not show a signed-in user's name, avatar, account details, or private user data.
Show four real aggregate statistics computed from the MySQL data: total products, category count, on-sale products, and low-stock warning count. These must not be hard-coded demo values.
Public rendering may read aggregate counts only; never expose product rows, SKU values, exact stock quantities, admin data, or arbitrary filters through a public endpoint.
The low-stock warning count is intentionally public per the user's request; document that this reveals an aggregate inventory signal.
Help and contact can be simple public template pages.

public_statistics.source: live aggregate queries over MySQL data
public_statistics.refresh: render from current database values on page request; optional short cache only if documented

cards.label: 在售商品
cards.definition: count of products with status on_sale

cards.label: 库存预警
cards.definition: count of products whose stock_quantity <= warning_threshold

public_statistics.empty_state: show 0 when there is no matching data

build.source_dir: resources/admin; the SPA source (index.html, src/, package.json, vite.config.js) must live outside the web root. Never place it under public/, where a static server exposes the source and serves public/admin/index.html for /admin/* URLs instead of the built dist file
build.entry_html: resources/admin/index.html must reference ./src/main.js as a relative path; never /admin/src/main.js, which breaks vite build resolution
build.vite_base: /admin/dist/ because the built index.html lives in public/admin/dist and is served by the /admin/* route; the default '/admin/' base makes asset URLs miss the dist folder
build.verify: npm run build from resources/admin succeeds, public/admin contains only dist, and /admin/src/main.js is not downloadable

authentication.self_service_registration: disabled; no registration page, route, or API
authentication.session: same-origin server-side session cookie with HttpOnly and SameSite protections

session_wiring.global_middleware: app/middleware.php must return [think\middleware\SessionInit::class]; without it the request has no session store and $request->session() throws 'Call to a member function get() on null'
session_wiring.api: read and write session through think\facade\Session: get/set/delete/clear/destroy/regenerate. Request::session($name, $default) is a read-only reader; passing a value there silently does nothing
session_wiring.public_routes: login, logout and csrf must be registered outside the AdminAuth middleware group, otherwise the login request is rejected by the auth middleware itself

route_wiring.form: define controller routes as array callables [Controller::class, 'method']; a string rule such as 'Api\Auth/login' is parsed as a literal class name and fails with 'class not exists:Api\Auth'
route_wiring.why: array form removes namespace guessing and case sensitivity between the route string and the declared controller namespace

backend.responsibility: render public templates, serve authenticated JSON admin APIs, enforce validation and business rules, and access MySQL

authentication.initial_admin: one-time local CLI bootstrap only when no admin exists; prompt for password without echo; never include default credentials
authentication.password_storage: PHP password_hash with PASSWORD_DEFAULT; verify with password_verify; never store or log plaintext

products.status_display_rule: stock quantity 0 displays 缺货; otherwise use the configured product state label

categories.source_of_truth: MySQL categories table; do not hard-code category options in Vue components
categories.management_ui: No separate category-management page is specified by the supplied screenshots; keep this list seeded and database-backed unless the user requests category CRUD.

save_and_restore_defaults.save: persist every settings value as a keyed row in the settings table
save_and_restore_defaults.restore_defaults: reset every settings row to its documented default value; never delete categories, products, stock movements, or admins
save_and_restore_defaults.confirmation: restore defaults requires a second explicit confirmation in the admin UI before applying

rules: stock adjustments create a movement record
operation_log_rules: append a row on every authenticated state-changing admin action (create, update, delete, stock adjustment, settings save, settings restore)
detail stores a short JSON summary of the change; never store passwords, tokens, or full request bodies
retention is controlled by the operation_log_retention_days setting
a scheduled cleanup deletes rows older than the retention window

safety: Do not include or echo the database root password supplied in chat.
Generate .env.example with placeholders only; never generate a real .env file.
Do not connect to, create, migrate, or modify a database during generation.
Do not install packages or run shell commands; only print manual next steps.
Do not generate default admin credentials or public registration.
Do not put SMTP passwords, mail tokens, API keys, or database passwords in generated files; mail credentials live only in the local project .env and are referenced by placeholder variable names.

rules: Use this value as the initial selection when creating a product.
If the saved default category is unavailable, choose the first active category and show a safe fallback.

system_settings.storage: key/value rows in the MySQL settings table; one row per setting key

fields.default: 云仓商品库存管理平台
fields.description: store/platform display name shown on the public site header and admin title
low-stock threshold applied to a product when its own threshold is unset
master switch for low-stock email notifications
initial category selection on the product create form
operation log rows older than this are deleted by the scheduled cleanup
send the daily low-stock summary email when true and notification_enabled is true
comma-separated recipient email addresses; empty means no recipient and the mail is skipped
local time HH:mm at which the daily low-stock email is sent

system_settings.save: POST /api/admin/settings persists the submitted keys; validate types and ranges before writing
system_settings.restore_defaults: POST /api/admin/settings/restore-defaults resets every settings row to its documented default; requires a second explicit confirmation; logs the action to operation_logs
system_settings.read: GET /api/admin/settings returns the current values with their defaults for the restore-defaults UI

scheduled_tasks.name: daily-low-stock-email
scheduled_tasks.behavior: when notification_enabled and low_stock_email_enabled are true and recipients is non-empty, query products whose stock_quantity <= warning_threshold and send one summary email listing product name, category, and current stock; skip sending when there are zero low-stock products or no recipients
scheduled_tasks.safety: never include admin data, passwords, or SMTP credentials in the email body; never write credentials to the database

scheduled_tasks.name: operation-log-cleanup
scheduled_tasks.behavior: delete operation_logs rows older than operation_log_retention_days; default 90 days

mail.credentials_source: local project .env only; never commit real SMTP passwords or API keys to the repository
mail.env_example_placeholders: MAIL_HOST=smtp.example.com / MAIL_PORT=465 / MAIL_USERNAME=replace-with-sender / MAIL_PASSWORD=replace-with-app-password / MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS=noreply@example.com / MAIL_FROM_NAME=云仓库存平台 / MAIL_ENCRYPTION=ssl
rules: The generated project must provide .env.example with placeholders only; never a real .env.
The mailer reads credentials from env at runtime; credentials are never hard-coded in PHP source.
If MAIL_PASSWORD is empty or unset, the daily email task logs a warning and skips sending instead of crashing.
